description: Defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for a generic doubly linked quicklist implementation, including node structures, iterators, and related operations.

methods.name: quicklistCreate
methods.description: Creates a new empty quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistNew
methods.description: Creates a new quicklist with specified fill and compression depth.

methods.name: quicklistSetCompressDepth
methods.description: Sets the compression depth for a quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistSetFill
methods.description: Sets the fill factor for a quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistSetOptions
methods.description: Sets fill and compression options for a quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistRelease
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistPushHead
methods.description: Pushes a value to the head of the quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistPushTail
methods.description: Pushes a value to the tail of the quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistPush
methods.description: Pushes a value to either head or tail based on 'where'.

methods.name: quicklistAppendZiplist
methods.description: Appends a ziplist to the quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistAppendValuesFromZiplist
methods.description: Creates a quicklist from a ziplist.

methods.name: quicklistCreateFromZiplist
methods.description: Creates a quicklist from a ziplist with fill and compression options.

methods.name: quicklistInsertAfter
methods.description: Inserts a value after a specified node.

methods.name: quicklistInsertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a value before a specified node.

methods.name: quicklistDelEntry
methods.description: Deletes an entry pointed to by an iterator.

methods.name: quicklistReplaceAtIndex
methods.description: Replaces the value at a specific index.

methods.name: quicklistDelRange
methods.description: Deletes a range of entries.

methods.name: quicklistGetIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the quicklist in a specified direction.

methods.name: quicklistGetIteratorAtIdx
methods.description: Returns an iterator at a specific index.

methods.name: quicklistNext
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next entry.

methods.name: quicklistReleaseIterator
methods.description: Releases an iterator.

methods.name: quicklistDup
methods.description: Duplicates a quicklist.

methods.name: quicklistIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an entry at a specific index.

methods.name: quicklistRewind
methods.description: Rewinds an iterator to the start.

methods.name: quicklistRewindTail
methods.description: Rewinds an iterator to the end.

methods.name: quicklistRotate
methods.description: Rotates the list.

methods.name: quicklistPopCustom
methods.description: Pops a value from the list with custom handling.

methods.name: quicklistPop
methods.description: Pops a value from the list.

methods.name: quicklistCount
methods.description: Returns total count of entries.

methods.name: quicklistCompare
methods.description: Compares two entries.

methods.name: quicklistGetLzf
methods.description: Retrieves LZF compressed data from a node.
